Package org.apache.hadoop.yarn.server.resourcemanager.scheduler.constraint.api

Interface ConstraintPlacementAlgorithm

All Known Implementing Classes:
DefaultPlacementAlgorithm
public interface ConstraintPlacementAlgorithm
Marker interface for a Constraint Placement. The only contract is that it should be initialized with the RMContext.
